<thought>Based on the molecular ion (m/z 179.0946) the formula is C10H13NO2. The ¹H NMR shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (4 aromatic protons), a methoxy singlet (3 H), and two equivalent –CH₂–CH₂– triplets (2 H each) adjacent to the aromatic ring and a carbonyl. This matches 4‑methoxy‑phenethyl‑amide: COc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)N. The SMILES is therefore valid for the described data.</thought>
<final_answer>COc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)N</final_answer>
